title: Braced Single-Bay Pallet Rack
description: Original complete single-bay pallet rack with two braced upright frames, four grounded feet, paired front/rear upper bearing beams and visible beam-end connectors. Twenty-two editable closed parts in one static assembly. Frozen pallet fit is verified using six actual bottom-runner contact patches and displaced-pallet/missing-beam negatives. Upper pallet placement is static context only; original manual jack remains on the floor. No lifting, load rating, anchoring, stability or continuous handling certification.
